build_DABDETRHead: build a DAB-DETR detection head with dynamic anchor boxes for object detection
init_DABDETRHead_layers: initialize the classification and regression layers of the DABDETRHead model
init_DABDETRHead_weights: initialize the DABDETRHead weights with sigmoid bias and constant regression init
run_DABDETRHead_forward: run the DABDETRHead forward pass to get classification scores and bounding box predictions
predict_DABDETRHead: predict detection results using DABDETRHead with transformer decoder hidden states and references
